name: Sigge Labor
profile: Swedish developer and Hyper Island graduate who worked as a full-stack engineer at startups before co-founding legal-AI company Leya (now Legora). He and August Erséus began building legal AI in 2020, revived it in 2023 with LLMs and recruited Max Junestrand as CEO; Legora went through YC W24 and has been valued at ~$5.5B+.
interesting_fact: Legora started as a 2020 experiment using Google's BERT on legal text; it was shelved because pre-LLM models couldn't handle nuanced (especially non-English) legal language, then revived in 2023.
deep_cut_fact: His own YC bio says he 'founded the first-ever Mexican hops company' and jokingly lists his skills as family tech support - resetting grandparents' forgotten email passwords.
notes: Lower public profile than CEO Max Junestrand; route via Legora press office.

name: Preston Ellis
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Axiom (Axiom Exchange, DeFi trading platform; YC W25)
profile: UC Berkeley EECS student-turned-founder (known online as 'Cal') who co-founded Axiom with CEO Henry Zhang to let users trade memecoins, perpetuals and yield across DeFi in one app. Axiom reported ~$100M in revenue within four months of launch on just a $500K YC pre-seed.
interesting_fact: Axiom reached about $100M in revenue four months after launch, with ~22-year-old founders.
deep_cut_fact: Before Axiom he interned at DoorDash while studying EECS at UC Berkeley, and had already notched one startup exit as an undergraduate.
notes: Crypto trading platform; limited fit for energy/data-center podcast. Founders operate pseudonymously online (Mist/Cal).

name: Dave Sweyer
current_role: Founder, majority owner and adviser, Vantaca (HOA/community-association management software, Wilmington NC)
profile: Wilmington, NC entrepreneur who owned and ran an HOA management company (CAMS) for about 30 years before co-founding Vantaca with David Gunn (company dates its founding to 2015) to build the software his own firm couldn't buy. He handed the CEO role to ex-Navy officer Ben Currin in 2020 but remains majority owner; Vantaca has since raised from JMI Equity and others at a $1B+ valuation.
interesting_fact: About 75M+ Americans live in community associations, a market JMI says was underserved by cloud software; Vantaca now markets itself as AI-first ('HOAi').
deep_cut_fact: Vantaca began as in-house software for his own HOA management company - the industry had nothing that met its needs - so his firm was effectively Vantaca's first customer.
notes: Operator-turned-software founder; no longer CEO. Local coverage in Wilmington Business Journal. Route via Vantaca.

name: Michele Mancioppi
current_role: Co-founder, Chief Architect and Head of Open Source & Community, Dash0
profile: Italian-born observability veteran: staff engineer at SAP (led a company-wide observability effort for SAP Cloud Platform), Senior Technical PM at Instana, then observability PM at Canonical and Lumigo before co-founding Dash0 in 2023. He is an OpenTelemetry maintainer co-leading the Injector and Packaging SIGs; Dash0 hit a $1B valuation in 2026.
interesting_fact: He co-created OTelBin, the visual editor for OpenTelemetry Collector configurations, and the Instrumentation Score open spec for measuring telemetry quality.
deep_cut_fact: His Dash0 bio says he 'hates bad software in a personal fashion'; he was the first guest on Dash0's Code RED podcast ('Making software that doesn't suck'). Leading SAP Cloud Platform's observability effort is what first got him hooked on the field.
notes: Frequent conference speaker (KubeCon, Observability Day) and podcast guest (o11ycast ep. 68); approachable via X.
